items.name: ExprProperties
items.summary: Represents the properties of a `PhysicalExpr`, including its sorting, range, and whether it preserves lexicographical ordering.

methods.name: new_unknown
methods.summary: Creates a new `ExprProperties` instance with unknown sort properties, unknown range, and unknown lexicographical ordering preservation.

methods.name: with_order
methods.summary: Sets the sorting properties of the expression and returns the modified instance.

methods.name: with_preserves_lex_ordering
methods.summary: Sets whether the expression maintains lexicographical ordering and returns the modified instance.

methods.name: with_range
methods.summary: Sets the range of the expression and returns the modified instance.

methods.name: with_strictly_order_preserving
methods.summary: Sets whether the expression is strictly order-preserving and returns the modified instance.
